messages:
Priya (PM): dropped Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz1111/first-run-launchpad-v2
Priya (PM): decision: compact launch chip vs full grid launchpad for first-time workspaces. metric goal: increase sample starts without bumping dismiss complaints. need copy + a11y checks + tracking names.

Elaine (Designer): chip is subtle and can expand into a tray with 3 curated samples. grid helps discovery for unfamiliar users. chip less visual noise on small screens.

Jon (UX): small study hint: adding "~5 minutes" near CTA increases clicks. but heavy grids can overwhelm. suggest test chip (with time tag) vs grid (with thumbnails). include quick intercept on dismiss.

Mike (Frontend): both doable. grid needs lazy image loading and accessible card buttons. chip needs expand animation and persisted state. I'll ensure focus management and DOM order.

Sofia (Accessibility): checklist: color contrast for caption text, aria-expanded on chip button, aria-live polite for newly revealed tray content, ensure close buttons have SR labels like "Dismiss onboarding". avoid trapping focus except inside modal dialogs.

Sam (Devex): tracking events: launchpad_shown (chip|grid), launchpad_opened, sample_started, launchpad_skipped, dismiss_reason, experiment_id. will gate on telemetry_consent and add flag launchpad_variant.

Elaine (Designer): copy options to A/B:
- Warm: "Try a sample project — ~5 min" CTA: "Open sample" Secondary: "Later"
- Direct: "Start with a sample" CTA: "Use sample" Secondary: "Skip"
Which tone should we prioritize?

Priya (PM): prefer Warm first. keep microcopy that mentions what the sample showcases (chat/embeddings).

Jon (UX): add a small trust note for samples that use keys: "Runs in your workspace only" to reduce privacy friction.

Mike (Frontend): CSS sketch for chip expand:
```css
.launch-chip { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 20px; z-index: 60; }
.launch-tray[aria-expanded="true"] { transform: translateY(0); }
```
I'll open a draft PR with DOM reorder so dismiss is first in tab sequence.

Sofia (Accessibility): please use semantic color tokens not hex so themes stay consistent. I'll review PR for NVDA/VoiceOver checks.

Sam (Devex): flag plan: internal 100% chip; external A/B: 20% grid, 20% chip, rest control. metric gates: sample_start uplift and dismiss rate < 9%.

launch-bot: reminder — run axe smoke + keyboard navigation e2e on PRs.

Priya (PM): action items: Elaine update frames + contrast numbers; Mike PR with focus changes; Sam add events + flag; Sofia a11y review; Jon set up intercept. target: Wed EOD for assets and draft PRs. :thumbsup:

Elaine (Designer): on it  will post updated prototypes tomorrow with mobile behaviour and both copy tones.

Priya (PM): thanks team — will reconvene after canary metrics. ping here for blockers.
